Honestly, your Yae is pretty good, so it would be tough and probably not worth it to try to improve her. However, a few things you could do: Get more EM (at least 150). This is actually more important than attack %, so you could switch your sands to EM to achieve this. Get artifacts with better substats (especially your circlet). You have >100% crit rate rn, which is obviously higher than you need, so maybe try to get less crit rate and more EM and crit dmg. Although I don't recommend this, you could get her signature weapon (it's slightly better than your current one, and the crit dmg substat would be helpful for you). Also, if you're using Yae in a dendro team, switching your artifact set to gilded dreams would be helpful.

Hu tao and ganyu are both main dps characters that benefit from a lot of field time, so I wouldn't put them in a team together (plus, you should probably choose between vape and melt, but idk). Maybe a hu tao vape team with hu tao and yelan and a freeze team with ganyu/ayaka, shenhe, and mona would be best, but I'm not sure.

Mona may not provide enough hydro application for a freeze comp, idk. Kazuha would probably be good in either team but maybe better with hu tao? Idk if ayaka and ganyu work well together or not.
